title: VPN authentication timeout in Singapore
resolution: Restart LDAP authentication service and verify replication.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
resolution: Increase pool size and restart application.

title: DNS resolution failure for internal services
resolution: Flush DNS cache and restart DNS service.

title: Disk usage exceeded 95 percent
resolution: Remove unnecessary files and expand storage.

title: Firewall blocked VPN traffic
resolution: Update firewall rules to allow VPN ports.

title: SSL certificate expired on web server
resolution: Renew SSL certificate and restart web server.

title: Application crashed due to memory leak
resolution: Deploy patched version and restart service.

title: API gateway returned 502 errors
resolution: Restart gateway and verify upstream services.

title: High CPU utilization on authentication server
resolution: Restart authentication service and investigate running processes.
